record.t: Became the 171st Speaker of the New Jersey General Assembly.
record.q: Assemblyman Coughlin became the 171st Speaker of the New Jersey General Assembly in January of 2018.

record.t: Joined the Assembly in 2010 and represents Legislative District 19.
record.q: Craig Coughlin first joined the Assembly in 2010 and currently represents Legislative District 19 which includes the municipalities of Carteret, Perth Amboy, Sayreville, South Amboy, and Woodbridge.

record.t: Announced with the Governor and the Senate President that the State is accelerating delivery of food and hunger grants to food banks.
record.q: Governor Phil Murphy, Senate President Nick Scutari, and Assembly Speaker Craig Coughlin today announced that the State is accelerating the delivery of food and hunger grants to Emergency Food Organizations (EFOs), or food banks

record.t: Came up with a plan, with Senate President Stephen Sweeney, to amend the state Constitution on drawing districts.
record.q: New Jersey state Senate President Stephen Sweeney and Assembly Speaker Craig Coughlin, both Democrats, came up with a plan that would have amended the state Constitution to give them more power in drawing up districts.

record.t: Previously served as the Assembly's Parliamentarian and Deputy Parliamentarian.
record.q: He previously held the positions of the Chamber’s Parliamentarian and the Deputy Parliamentarian.

record.office: Municipal Court Judge, Township of Edison
record.t: Served as Edison Township Municipal Court Judge from 2005 to 2009, South Amboy Councilman from 1987 to 1993, and a South Amboy Board of Education member from 1983 to 1987.
record.q: he served his community as Township of Edison Municipal Court Judge from 2005-2009, South Amboy Councilman from 1987-1993, and as a member South Amboy Board of Education from 1983-1987.

record.t: Sits on the Legislative Services Commission.
